died.name: John II of Castile
died.last_words: Were I born the son of a farmer, and became a friar of the Abrojo, and not the king of Castile.

died.name: Archibald Johnston
died.last_words: Abba, Father, accept this, Thy poor sinful servant, coming unto Thee through the merits of Jesus Christ. O pray, pray! praise, praise!

died.name: Barnard Elliott Bee Jr.
died.desc: Confederate general of the American Civil War
died.cause: before being mortally wounded at the First Battle of Bull Run. His last words gave rise to the nickname of Thomas J. "Stonewall" Jackson
died.last_words: There is Jackson standing like a stone wall! Rally behind the Virginians. Let us determine to die here and we will conquer. Follow me.

died.name: Florenz Ziegfeld Jr.
died.last_words: Curtain! Fast music! Lights! Ready for the last finale! Great! The show looks good. The show looks good.

died.name: Toni Kurz
died.cause: dying on the Eiger north face

born.name: Margaret Mary Alacoque
born.desc: French Roman Catholic nun, promoter of devotion to the Sacred Heart of Jesus
born.last_words: I need nothing but God, and to lose myself in the heart of Jesus.

born.name: James Whale
born.desc: English film and theater director and actor
born.last_words: The future is just old age and illness and pain... I must have peace and this is the only way.

born.name: Arthur Seyss-Inquart
born.desc: Austrian Nazi politician, Reichskommissar of the occupied Netherlands
born.cause: prior to his execution by hanging for war crimes and crimes against humanity (Nuremberg executions)
born.last_words: I hope that this execution is the last act of the tragedy of the Second World War and that the lesson taken from this world war will be that peace and understanding should exist between peoples. I believe in Germany.

born.name: Sobhuza II
born.desc: King of Swaziland, longest verifiably-reigning monarch in recorded history
born.cause: to his minister of health after halting a meeting

born.name: Anthony T. Kahoʻohanohano
born.desc: United States Army soldier and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: prior to being killed in action in the Korean War

born.name: Vaughn Bodē
born.last_words: Mark, I've seen God four times, and I'm going to see him again soon. That's No. 1 to me, and you're No. 2.
